rationale: Reviewed Copilot-only manifest, ten compact dispatcher-first skills, required contracts, exact-version runtime, Delivery Path Search input-integrity provenance, evidence-plane separation, shared run-identity validation, fail-closed localized QA, UAT and task-target values, terminal unresolved-target behavior, complete user-facing locale binding, localized CD+Tests actions and repository-aware SessionStart classification. The executable skill dispatcher adds exactly two bounded runtime files, strict registry validation, fail-closed deterministic presentation, one always-available non-authorizing binding, a machine-readable host_action carrying the exact terminal text, machine-readable ordinary-conversation, runtime-mention, activation, pre-dispatch and terminal-output constraints, silent SessionStart context, and delayed loading of shared target and interaction contracts while retaining consent-gated repository checks. Request Activation adds one canonical runtime-contract file, a fingerprint-bound passive guard projected into the router and all ten skills, definition-owned module inventory, silent ordinary-request abstention, and passive binding identity without another hook, classifier, prompt transport, or dispatcher field. The reviewed atomic canonical-init, strict lifecycle-envelope, stale-package cleanup, host-evidence schema, and control-setup continuation changes raise the measured payload to 85 files/696486 bytes. Any further increase requires review. SD2 transport correction adds exactly one shared runtime binding module, changing the file ceiling from 85 to 86. The byte ceiling remains 696486; the regenerated candidate measures 679898 bytes. Instruction budgets, activation kernel and hook inventory are unchanged. Approved host-adapter compatibility extraction adds exactly five pure runtime command modules (four host leaves and one shared formatter), raising the reviewed file ceiling from 86 to 91. The regenerated candidate measures 682058 bytes, below the unchanged 696486-byte ceiling.
